'''Volume 2''' is the second of four omnibus volumes of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. It was published by [[Shogakukan Asia]] in {{pmin|Singapore}}, although it uses [[VIZ Media]]'s translation. This volume contains all the chapters originally found in {{PAV|17}} and {{PAV|18}}.

==Major events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{adv|Ruby}} escapes from the [[Submarine Explorer 1]].
* {{adv|Sapphire}} fights [[New Mauville]]'s power generator. [[Wattson]] thanks her by giving her the {{badge|Dynamo}}.
* Ruby catches a {{p|Feebas}}.
* [[Norman]] battles Ruby at the [[Weather Institute]]. He lets his son compete at [[Pokémon Contest]]s.
* [[Matt]] lures Sapphire into the [[Mt. Chimney]] cable car by using [[Flannery]] as a bait. Sapphire defeats him.
* [[Team Aqua]] manages to end the volcanic activity of Mt. Chimney.
* [[Tabitha]] helps [[Flannery]] in her attempt to revive [[Mt. Chimney]].
* {{adv|Sapphire}} defeats Flannery.
* {{adv|Ruby}} participates in, and wins, Normal Rank [[Pokémon Contest]]s in all in categories.
* Ruby meets [[Wanda]].
* [[Team Magma]] blow the [[Rusturf Tunnel]] up.
* [[Courtney]] asks Ruby to join Team Magma.
* The [[Gym Leader]]s hold a crisis meeting in [[Fortree City]].
* Ruby participates in Super Rank Pokémon Contests.
* Ruby meets [[Wallace]] and becomes his student.
* Ruby and Sapphire encounter one another again.
